column1: # CHAOS-8305: registrations that ONLY REFUSE. net/http would answer a different status or Allow header without them
# (Python/Starlette's first-partial-match 405), so they exist but serve nothing and have no profile row. Columns (tab
# separated): method, registered pattern, a concrete probe path, the refusal status, file:line of the registration. The gate
# EXECUTES each probe against the built server and requires the status; an entry whose route is gone, or that has a profile
# row, or whose probe answers anything else, fails.
